        l.duration AS loan_duration,
        l.payments AS loan_payments,
        l.status AS loan_status
    FROM

),
risk_assessment AS (

WITH yearly_sets AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS year,
        language
    FROM 
        sets
    INNER JOIN 
        set_translations ON sets.code = set_translations.setCode
    WHERE 
        releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    year,
    language,
    COUNT(*) AS set_count
FROM 
    yearly_sets
GROUP BY 
    year, language
ORDER BY 
    set_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
